name: Dan O'Leary
mentions: …Among other things, he claims to be the champion six-days' pedestrian and also the only man who ever defeated O'Leary. We don't know whether to wonder more at Harriman's nerve or the gullibility of the reporters. Harriman has no best on record of any kind for any distance. He is a fair…

…amp of 2,500 miles in fifty-four days. It was a test case wherein Weston represented total abstinence and Dan O'Leary the whiskey men. Temperance won and Weston is to receive a purse of $2,000 from his prohibition friends in New York.
